_comment: Model registry. Edit freely; no secrets here. Model IDs are configuration, not code. IDs below were checked against each provider's official documentation on 2026-10-16 (docs/ai-verification.md). A model ID being listed is NOT proof that YOUR account can use it: run the live verification. reasoningEffort is sent to the provider to bound hidden reasoning tokens (which are billed as output).

models.label: Ollama llama3.1 8B (local)
models.notes: Runs on this machine (CPU on the dev PC: roughly 2-3 tokens/sec, so one attempt takes about 2 minutes). Free, offline, no key. Temperature 0. MEASURED 2026-10-16: 0 of 3 briefs passed validation even with one repair attempt (the 8B model overshoots the character limits), so treat this entry as plumbing/experimental, not as a reliable brief generator. Default served context is 4096 tokens; prompts that would not fit are refused rather than silently truncated.
